description: Buy a fixed dollar amount of one token on a schedule.

TOKEN.description: which token, exactly: the contract address the owner picked from a card listing each match's name, chain and address — a Solana mint verbatim, or ETH, BNB or SOL for a chain's own coin. A ticker buys nothing

CHAIN_ID.description: the chain the owner confirmed TOKEN on, picked on the same card, as a numeric id: Base 8453, Ethereum 1, BSC 56, Arbitrum 42161, Robinhood 4663, Solana 1151111081099710

SIZING.description: dollar-cost averaging is fixed-size by definition
